observations.behavior: Adds ResolutionError to the imported exceptions, alongside QueryError.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the HogQL query resolver to raise a distinct exception when a query is ambiguous, rather than only raising QueryError. This supports clearer diagnostics for queries that cannot be resolved, such as those with ambiguous unqualified column names or conflicting joins.
